entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case.
No such occurrence, in the manner as alleged has ever taken place.

It is further submitted that vide order dated 09.08.2023 passed in Cr. Misc. No.41160 of 2023 by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court, further proceedings of the court below in connection with present Aiyapur P.S. Case No.274/2021 was stayed with regard to the petitioner.

5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that there is no apprehension of the petitioner to be apprehended by the police in the present case, this anticipatory bail application has become infructuous.
6. This application is accordingly dismissed with a liberty to the petitioner to renew his prayer for anticipatory bail, if any adverse order is passed in the aforesaid quashing application.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) pallavi/-
